purpose: Form language board — design rationale with flow-curves motif, geometry extraction, interaction zone mapping
prompt: Design language board for 'VibeFlow' compact input device showing form evolution and design principles. Clean board layout on warm neutral background #F2EDE8. Title 'Design Language' in geometric sans-serif bold at top-left. Left column: design element extraction studies — a rounded rectangle geometry diagram showing 12mm corner radius, a coral #E8735A to amber #F5A623 gradient band swatch showing smooth transition, a material contrast diagram showing matte surface #F2EDE8 vs gloss-white #FAFAF7 vs semi-transparent frosted material, and a graphite #4A464D tone sample. Center: the product in Creative Coral colorway shown in 3/4 angle, with flow-curves motif lines overlaid showing the organic geometry. Right column: interaction zone layout diagram — a simplified top-view schematic showing touch strip (left edge, labeled), rotary knob (top-right, labeled), AI key cluster (right of spacebar, labeled), magnetic expansion port (right edge, labeled), with soft arc lines suggesting gesture motion paths. Annotations in monospace font. Flow-curves motif throughout as decorative organic arcs. Professional design presentation board aesthetic.
negative_prompt: dark background, gaming aesthetics, RGB lighting, cluttered layout, no diagrams, pure white background, pure black background, messy, AI brain graphics, hex patterns, neural net nodes
